title: موس با سس مرغ | Voskes
heading: MOUSSE WITH SAUCE CHICKEN
description: The mousse with chicken-rich sauce is a tasty and functional snack specially developed to responsibly spoil your cat. This cup is prepared with chicken and contains only natural ingredients. In addition, the snack is completely grain-free, making it suitable even for cats with sensitive digestion. Thanks to the addition of sunflower oil, a natural source of omega fatty acids, this snack supports healthy skin and a shiny coat. This way, your cat not only enjoys a delicious treat but also receives valuable support for its health.
